Subject: Re: Post-call: Security materials & pen-test request

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the recap and for moving quickly. A few clarifying items from our security team:

- SOC 2: we require SOC 2 Type II (most recent period). A summary is fine to start but the security team will request the full report under an NDA.
- Pen test: we need evidence of an annual third-party pentest and would prefer the last report (redacted is ok). Please include the test vendor name and the high/critical findings and remediation confirmation.
- Vulnerability management: please provide your SLA windows for remediation (critical/high/medium), scanning cadence (internal/external), and your process for CVE tracking and disclosure to customers.
- Vendor questionnaire: our procurement uses OneTrust for the formal questionnaire — I will route an invitation to your team, but please also share the questionnaire link if you have a pre-filled copy.

Additionally, security wants us to route the final pen-test PDF to security-ops@healthtech.io (they'll manage the redaction internally if needed). For legal/contracting: procurement may request a compliance contact and a SOC2 signer to get the NDA in place.

If you can get the redacted pen-test and the vulnerability management summary to us by EOD Thursday, that would be great. After that we'll aim for a review meeting the following week.

Thanks —
Emily Jones
Director, InfoSec | HealthTech, Inc.
emily.jones@healthtech.io

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security materials & pen-test request

Emily —

Appreciate the clarity. Answers below (summary) and I've attached the redacted pen-test and our security summary as requested.

SOC 2
- Type: SOC 2 Type II
- Period: Report for 2025 (summary attached). Full report available under NDA; we can sign and route to your legal contact.

Pen test
- Last independent pentest: Oct 2025 by BlueHat Security (third party).
- Attachment: PenTest_Redacted_Oct2025.pdf (redacted report; vendor name included).
- Findings: No open critical findings at time of report; 1 high and several medium findings that were remediated and verified in follow-up testing. The redacted doc includes remediation notes.

Vulnerability management & SLAs
- Scanning cadence: automated external scans weekly; internal scans weekly; authenticated scans monthly; full external+internal assessments quarterly.
- Remediation SLAs: Critical: 72 hours from detection/triage; High: 7 days; Medium: 30 days; Low: per release schedule.
- Triage: 24-hour initial triage for critical/high findings; bug tracking in Jira with severity tagging and owner assignment.
- Disclosure/process: We maintain a coordinated disclosure policy; public CVEs are tracked via our security tracker and patched according to SLA above. We also offer customers a CVE summary on request for incidents affecting their data.
- Bug bounty / external researchers: we have a private bounty program and a vulnerability disclosure policy; triage window is 14 days to acknowledge and start remediation.

Questionnaire & links
- Pre-filled questionnaire link (read-only): https://redwood.app/one-trust/questionnaire/HT-2026-001
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765

Attachments included: Redwood_Security_Summary_2026.pdf, PenTest_Redacted_Oct2025.pdf

Next steps
- I can route the full SOC 2 under NDA to your legal contact — please provide the best email/address for that.
- If it helps, I'll schedule a 30-min sync Thurs 10:00am ET (your calendar permitting) with our security lead (Marissa) to walk through the pen-test and remediation process.

Would you like me to send the pen-test report directly to security-ops@healthtech.io as you requested?

Thanks,
Rishi
